notes:
This preview targets background loading and scrolling responsiveness on TV.

- Save navigation and scroll state off the UI thread, coalescing rapid changes.
- Keep loaded feeds readable while the disk cache is being written.
- Remove duplicate startup/resume refresh requests.
- Limit simultaneous thumbnail loading and decoding.

Existing subscriptions, saved selection, Family pairing and playback handlers are preserved. Feed refresh and withdrawal rules remain unchanged.

Both build variants pass 135 unit tests, Android lint and release assembly. Emulator feed navigation and Home/resume were checked. Performance improvement on physical TVs still needs testing.

Install over your existing signed preview; no uninstall is needed.
